title: Generational ZGC: Sub-Millisecond Garbage Collection Tuning at 100GB Heap
coreConcept: Configuring generational ZGC colored pointers and load barriers to eliminate stop-the-world pauses on massive distributed backend nodes.
codeSnippet:
# JVM arguments for sub-millisecond ZGC pause time
java -XX:+UseZGC -XX:+ZGenerational \
     -Xms64g -Xmx64g \
     -XX:+UnlockDiagnosticVMOptions \
     -XX:GuaranteedSafepointInterval=0 \
     -jar backend-service.jar

jcmd <PID> VM.native_memory baseline
jcmd <PID> VM.native_memory detail.diff
